solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Nice dog guarding Charlie, York's ultimate scaredy-cat

indicators.note: a guard stands around what it protects, so the French dog encloses the other letters

parts.note: Nice is the French city, so its dog is the French word chien
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: ultimate means last, so only the final letter of York's is used

explanation.surface: A timid hound on the Riviera hides behind its keeper from Yorkshire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' with its capital looks like praise for the dog but is the French resort, so the dog is CHIEN; 'guarding' puts C and K (York's last letter) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a coward: a person too frightened to act is called this, like the timid farmyard bird.

clue.text: We corrupt dad's roly-poly pudding ingredient

indicators.note: roly-poly suggests rolling over and over, so these letters are tumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A family joke about father ruining a jam roly-poly pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corrupt' looks like the anagram signal but is part of the fodder; 'roly-poly', which seems to name the pudding, is the instruction to rearrange WE CORRUPT DADS.
explanation.definitionFit: A packet mix of cornflour, colouring and flavouring stirred with milk to make the yellow sauce poured over British desserts.

clue.text: Where the cat might get stuck when panicking

definitions.text: Where the cat might get stuck
definitions.meaning: a pet can wedge itself in the little swinging door cut into a house door for it
agitated and flustered, in a state of nervous excitement

explanation.surface: A pet wedged halfway through its little door, and fretting about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a flap is an idiom for being anxious and flustered; literally a cat can be caught in its cat flap.

clue.text: Partly remake Babette's Feast feature?

indicators.note: Partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A suggestion for a new version of the Danish film Babette's Feast.
explanation.definitionFit: Skewered grilled meat is the sort of dish that might appear at a banquet, a playful example rather than a synonym.

clue.text: Chesterfield stud had a line when sozzled

indicators.note: sozzled means very drunk, so these letters stagger into a different order

explanation.surface: A drunken stud from Chesterfield delivered a chat-up line.
explanation.walkthrough: A Chesterfield is a buttoned leather sofa, so the 'stud' is not a ladies' man but a decorative nail.
explanation.definitionFit: Chesterfield sofas are trimmed with rows of domed decorative tacks, each a stud.

clue.text: Ever more stupid, husband lost heart

indicators.note: lost says a letter goes missing from the word before it

parts.note: thicker means more stupid

explanation.surface: A man's foolishness grew until he lost heart altogether.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for the heart, from its steady beat like a clock's.

clue.text: Peg leg got broken

indicators.note: broken signals that these letters are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A peg leg that has snapped.
explanation.definitionFit: A toggle is a short wooden peg or bar passed through a loop to fasten a coat.

clue.text: Fossil-fuel dependent firm sacked a student entrant

indicators.note: an entrant goes in, so these letters enter the middle of the others

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
sacked means fired
L is for learner, a student driver's L-plate

explanation.surface: A company dependent on fossil fuels dismissed a new student recruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A power station burning coal relies on that fossil fuel to run.

clue.text: Metro burial exposed former core of Italy

indicators.note: something exposed has its covering stripped off, so each word loses its outer letters

explanation.surface: Ancient remains uncovered during work on the Rome metro.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exposed' strips the outer letters from each word: ETR from Metro and URIA from burial.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient land of the Etruscans in central Italy, before Rome's rise.

clue.text: Tottering along with fake jewellery?

parts.note: a sham is a fake
bling is slang for flashy jewellery

explanation.surface: Someone staggering about weighed down with gaudy costume jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: Walking awkwardly and unsteadily, dragging the feet, is the same as tottering.

clue.text: Labour A-team regularly shunned one bringing new blood

indicators.note: every other letter is regularly dropped, leaving only the alternate ones

explanation.surface: Labour's top team kept snubbing a newcomer meant to revitalise the party.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the odd letters of LABOUR A-TEAM leaves the even ones. 'New blood' looks political but means freshly oxygenated blood.
explanation.definitionFit: The main artery carries freshly oxygenated blood out of the heart to the body.

clue.text: Running the marathon is quite a tonic

indicators.note: running suggests letters set in motion, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A claim that running a marathon is a real pick-me-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for a boost of encouragement or energy, as a tonic invigorates.

clue.text: Answer German paper back freely

indicators.note: back says the newspaper's name is read in reverse

parts.note: Bild is a German tabloid newspaper

explanation.surface: Instructions to reply to a German paper without restriction.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking without a script, improvising, is speaking freely.

clue.text: Go on about the job of the banks in Alloa?

definitions.meaning: to talk at great length, holding the floor

definitions.text: the job of the banks in Alloa?
definitions.meaning: Alloa is a Scottish town on the River Forth, whose banks contain the river

explanation.surface: A question about what Scottish banks in Alloa do all day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banks' suggests financial institutions, but these are riverbanks keeping the Forth in its bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak lengthily and pompously; literally the river banks keep the Forth contained.

clue.text: Consular official, daughter, mother in international conspiracy

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another

parts.note: a plot is a conspiracy
ma is mother

explanation.surface: An embassy employee and her family caught up in a global intrigue.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone representing their country abroad, as embassy and consular staff do.

clue.text: Old, silly, soppiest characters attractive to one another?

indicators.note: silly signals a foolish jumbling of the letters

explanation.surface: A description of sentimental old-fashioned romantic types.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying goes that contrasting people are drawn together, as unlike poles attract.

clue.text: Wild animal consuming rabbit's head as a source of nourishment

indicators.note: consuming means eating, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a beast is a wild animal

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A predator eats a rabbit to feed itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A mother's milk comes from here, feeding her young.

clue.text: Niggling pain's returned, clipping Rachel's wings

parts.note: to come back is to return

indicators.note: clipping trims a bird so it cannot fly, so the ends come off
the wings of a word are its outer letters, which are cut away

explanation.surface: Rachel's nagging ache has come back, grounding her like a bird with cut feathers.
explanation.walkthrough: Clipping the wings of RACHEL leaves ACHE; the 's of the clue reads as 'is' after the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A persistent dull pain in the lower spine is a common nagging complaint.

clue.text: Fill Médoc cup you're holding

indicators.note: the words hold the answer within them, spanning their joins

explanation.surface: A request to pour Bordeaux wine into a waiting cup.
explanation.definitionFit: To take up a space or time completely is to fill it.

clue.text: Southern area captured by dirty, holy war

indicators.note: something captured is held inside its captor

parts.note: crude means dirty or vulgar

explanation.surface: A southern region overrun in a dirty religious war.
explanation.definitionFit: The medieval Christian campaigns to take the Holy Land were religious wars.

clue.text: Jack-of-all-trades sinking ¥1000 into Chinese martial art ranking

parts.note: the Han are the majority ethnic group of China

indicators.note: sinking means pushing something down into another
into marks where the sunk letters go

parts.note: a dan is a black-belt grade in judo or karate
the yen sign gives Y and the Roman numeral for 1000 is M

explanation.surface: Someone investing a thousand yen in a Chinese martial arts club.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who can turn their hand to any odd job around the house is a jack-of-all-trades.

clue.text: Wine bar left in possession of teetotallers

parts.note: a Mars bar is a British chocolate bar

indicators.note: held by, so the letter sits inside the other pair

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, whose members abstain

explanation.surface: A wine bar run by non-drinkers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wine bar' reads as one place, but the definition is 'Wine' alone and 'bar' is the chocolate. A Mars is a well-known British chocolate bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine from Sicily, also used in cooking.

clue.text: Bits of offal, thin slices, no starter

indicators.note: no starter means the first letter is removed

parts.note: slivers are thin slices

explanation.surface: A butcher's menu listing offal cut thin, with no first course.
explanation.definitionFit: The organs that filter blood are sold as offal for cooking.

clue.text: One used to beat son covered in foul muck and dirt?

indicators.note: covered in places the boy inside the other letters
foul suggests the letters are fouled up, jumbled

explanation.surface: A child caked in filth, perhaps about to get a hiding.
explanation.walkthrough: The '?' hints that the stick is not for punishment but for a drum; it is also a chicken leg, like other answers here.
explanation.definitionFit: A drummer strikes the skin with a pair of sticks.

clue.text: Light resistance, caught in flipping hot surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings enclose the other letters
flipping turns the word over, so it is written backwards

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An electrical light caught in an overheating casing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flipping' turns HOT into TOH, and 'surroundings' puts R and C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A handheld lamp or flame used to light the way.

clue.text: Tango on drugs, showing a bit of leg?

parts.note: Tango is T in the NATO phonetic alphabet
high means intoxicated by drugs

explanation.surface: A tango dancer under the influence, flashing some leg.
explanation.definitionFit: The upper part of the leg, above the knee; also a chicken joint like other answers here.

clue.text: Tear a strip off cook

definitions.meaning: to cook meat in an oven

explanation.surface: A chef being harshly told off.
explanation.definitionFit: It means both to criticise harshly and to cook in dry oven heat.

clue.text: Nurse a kid — adopted — eating a Mexican dish

indicators.note: adopted means taken on, so the letter is attached at the end

parts.note: EN is an enrolled nurse

indicators.note: eating takes a letter inside

parts.note: a kid is a child

explanation.surface: A nurse feeding an adopted child a Mexican meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rolled tortilla stuffed with filling and baked in chilli sauce, from Mexico.

clue.text: Mum's new partner's daughter taking temperature — it's an infection

indicators.note: taking means taking away, removing that letter

parts.note: a stepsister, shortened to step-sis

explanation.surface: A girl in a blended family is running a temperature from an infection.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood poisoning from bacteria spreading through the body is a serious infection.

clue.text: Joseph's boy's record target? About an hour

indicators.note: about means around, so the other letters go round this abbreviation

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
an aim is a target
HR is the abbreviation for hour

explanation.surface: A puzzling question about a biblical son's record attempt lasting an hour.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Joseph's younger son founded one of the tribes of Israel.
